I cannot guarantee investment returns or choose an investment for money you need for essential spending. Treat a promised high monthly return as a claim to verify independently, not as an assured way to pay rent or school fees.

Before risking essential savings, consider whether you could afford a loss and seek appropriately qualified, regulated advice. I can help you make a budget, compare clearly stated risks, or prepare questions to ask a provider. Do not share account details, passwords or security codes.
